headquarters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original playable 2D RPG room background, no characters or interface. Create a beautifully detailed crisp pixel-art cozy detective headquarters. Landscape image 1536x1024, orthogonal slightly elevated top-down RPG view, straight walls horizontal and vertical, NOT isometric. The room fills the entire image, no outer margins, text, watermark, logo, people, animals, or user interface. Pixel art with a consistent discrete pixel grid, dark brown outlines, rich restrained textures, forest-green painted wood, honey-brown wooden plank floor, warm cream plaster, muted burnt orange, deep olive foliage. Top quarter is the back wall and furniture: at upper left a tall green bookcase with files and books, at upper middle a broad golden sunlit window and small plants, at upper right a cork evidence board with blank papers and strings above low green cabinets. Below the window at center-top is a solid green wooden detective desk with a small beige CRT computer on its LEFT end, papers, green banker's lamp and a cream mug. Desk occupies only x=35%-60%, y=30%-43%. Left side middle has two small rust upholstered chairs and a tiny side table, leaving paths around them. Right side middle has narrow archive shelves and a few stacked files against the wall. Bottom right corner a small cozy animal basket next to a potted plant. Bottom center has an open wooden doorway threshold. The central and lower 50% of the image is spacious WALKABLE WOOD FLOOR with a muted terracotta rectangular rug, subtle sun streaks coming from the top window, and room for player movement. Keep floor visibly distinct from objects. All furniture viewed with tops and short vertical front faces at a consistent RPG angle. Clear silhouettes suitable for collision regions, meticulously handcrafted indie-game pixel art, delightful tiny book spines, leaves and paper details. Warm quiet afternoon, like a place a young detective would love to call home. Original composition and furniture designs.
cast: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art RPG character sprite atlas, transparent PNG, square 1024x1024. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equally sized 256x256 cells, NO gutters, NO labels, NO grid lines. Each cell contains exactly ONE small full body character centered horizontally, soles aligned at y=220 inside the cell, with ample empty transparent margin. All characters are the same scale, about 110 pixels wide and 170 pixels tall, consistent chunky pixel grid and dark brown outlines, limited warm palette, cozy top-down slightly elevated 2D RPG look, NOT isometric. All cells alpha transparent with NO shadows or backdrop. Each ROW is one character with FOUR directional views: column1 faces DOWN toward viewer; column2 faces LEFT; column3 faces RIGHT; column4 faces UP away from viewer. Row1: young detective with short chestnut hair, forest-green jacket, cream shirt, brown trousers, tan leather satchel, brown shoes. Row2: mentor woman with dark brown skin, rounded curly dark hair, round gold glasses, ochre cardigan over cream blouse, green skirt, dark boots. Row3: student with black bob hair, terracotta sweater, cream backpack straps, navy trousers, brown shoes. Row4: librarian woman with silver hair in bun, round glasses, burgundy cardigan, cream long skirt, brown shoes. Cute expressive faces and two-heads-tall proportions. Keep each character identity and colors identical across its four directions. Crisp handmade pixel art with visible square clusters; absolutely no smooth painted edges, no gradients, no text, no contact sheet background. Exact evenly spaced cell centers x=128,384,640,896, y=128,384,640,896. All 16 characters fully visible and separated.
walk: Transform the first-row young detective in the reference sprite atlas into a dedicated WALK ANIMATION sprite sheet. Output transparent PNG, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of evenly sized cells, each one centered and fully separated with clear transparent space, no labels or grid. Only this one character: chestnut short hair, green jacket, cream shirt, tan satchel, brown trousers and shoes. Match original pixel art, proportions and palette exactly. Row1 DOWN-facing walk cycle; Row2 LEFT-facing walk cycle; Row3 RIGHT-facing walk cycle; Row4 UP-facing walk cycle. Each row columns alternate step left foot forward, passing pose, right foot forward, passing pose. Visible arm and leg changes across frames, body anchored same position and soles same baseline in each cell. Each entire character fills about 60% of cell height. Crisp square pixel clusters and dark brown outlines, no smoothing, no shadows, no background, no labels. Transparent background.
